newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Average rate 4.67 pct on Swedish 12-month T-bill.
newsitem.headline: Average rate 4.67 pct on Swedish 12-month T-bill.

text.p: The average accepted rate in an auction of five billion crowns of 12-month Treasury bills was 4.67 percent, the National Debt Office said on Wednesday.
Bids of 19.22 billion crowns were received from 69 players for the 12-month maturity, the Debt Office said, and one player took the entire issue.

The Debt Office also auctioned three billion crowns of six-month paper, and the average accepted rate on this maturity was 4.52 percent, it said. Bids of 7.69 billion crowns were received from 29 bidders, and 15 bids were accepted.
